about: The synthetic data the Store screenshots show, in each listing language (LIST-8), read by capture.ps1: the phrase the Text action types, and for the App or link shot the search typed into the installed-apps list and the app chosen from it. The app is Task Manager, a classic Windows app whose name Windows translates (inbox Store apps such as Notepad keep their English names on the test VM). Its names are Windows' own: the Start menu shortcut's localized name, string 32420 of Taskmgr.exe's resources in each display language, read on the test VM on November 26, 2026. en-CA and fr-CA reuse en-US and fr-FR, as their listings do.
